resources.string: Turn a PDF into an editable Word, Excel or web page file.
Turn a Word, Excel or text file into a PDF.
Choose a PDF, then the type of file to make. Each page becomes a heading, so you can jump from page to page. Everything stays on your device.
Exact look (each page as a picture, followed by its text)
Excel conversion is basic and experimental. Only text is converted, with one sheet per page. Each line of text becomes a row, and columns are guessed from wide gaps. Please check the result.

resources.string: Choose a Word (docx), Excel (xlsx) or text (txt) file to turn into a PDF. Everything stays on your device.

Word files keep headings, bold paragraphs, lists, tables (one row per line) and inline pictures. Colours, fonts, headers, footers and floating shapes are not kept; a shape with a description appears as that description. Excel sheets become simple tables, without pictures. Old doc and xls files are not supported.
Choose Word, Excel or text file
Large sheets were cut: only the first %1$d rows and %2$d columns of a sheet are included.
\"%1$s\" could not be read. It may be damaged, protected with a password, or in an old format such as doc or xls. Save it as docx, xlsx or txt and try again.
